detached_structure.evidence: A small deck or structure with a lighter roof or platform sits attached to the west side of the central house, and a small white structure is at the southeast corner near the driveway. Neither is clearly a separate outbuilding.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray, flat-looking roof with some staining and sits in dense tree cover; two dark vehicles are parked in the driveway on its east side, and mature trees hide much of the yard.
